brief: A system monitor where CPU/memory are organisms — healthy breathes steady, stressed pulses fast

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor: glowing organism orbs evoke breathing life, conveying system health more poetically than typical bar/graph dashboards
Clean numeric hierarchy with restrained green/blue palette ties color semantics to organ identity and stress state
Dark canvas with soft radial glow gives the orbs a tactile, almost biological presence
dominant_weaknesses: Tooltip overlaps the 'Memory Organism' title, truncating it — a clear z-order/layout bug undermining craft
Vast empty space between header stats and the orb leaves the composition unbalanced; orbs float without anchoring grid
Static screenshot can't convey 'breathing vs pulsing' — without motion cue indicators, the core metaphor is invisible
fix_priorities: Resolve tooltip collision: reposition detail panel below stats or anchor to orb hover, never crossing the title
Tighten vertical rhythm — bring orbs closer to header or fill negative space with subtle waveform/heartbeat trace
Add a static visual hint of rhythm (concentric ripple rings, BPM label) so the breathing metaphor reads even still
Unify the two panels with a shared baseline grid; current centers feel slightly off between CPU and Memory sides
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective payoff from the organism metaphor, but behavioral clarity suffers because the tooltip collides and the breathing state isn't legible without animation.
rationale.intent_fit: The concept executes the brief conceptually — orbs as organisms with color-coded vitality — but the still frame and layout bugs leave the 'steady vs stressed pulse' distinction underexpressed.
